issues.description: Field mismatch for Person.firstName: In the template repository (src/common/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/model/Person.java) the field 'firstName' is declared private with public getter/setter, matching the UML/specification in the problem statement. In the solution repository (src/common/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/model/Person.java) the same field is declared public (public String firstName). This visibility difference (private vs. public) is a structural inconsistency that can confuse students about intended encapsulation and API usage (i.e., whether to access the field directly or via getters/setters).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent across template and solution. Prefer declaring 'firstName' as private with public getFirstName()/setFirstName() (as shown in the template and the UML in the problem statement). Update the field declaration in the solution repository to 'private String firstName;' and keep or verify the existing getter/setter to preserve encapsulation and avoid confusion.
